verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robotics simulation platform. Its documented interfaces are gz-transport messaging, C++ libraries, plugins and CLI tools, and they all target simulated worlds. Nothing in the evidence covers scoped credentials or authentication, AI-agent access, or commanding a physical robot end-to-end. Probes for llms.txt and an OpenAPI spec also returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an AI agent authenticate with scoped credentials and command a real robot end-to-end through the platform's API or SDK
